_doc: short_name (optional per region, GUIDE-222): <= 14 chars, the region name in the narrow Next steps panel (Places.short_region_name; falls back to name). map.ambient_critters (optional, GFX-086): [{kind: hen|duck|butterfly, pos: [x, y] inside the map, lays (optional, hens only, CRIT-001): {item: items.json id, chance: 0..1, feed (optional, CRIT-002): {item_tag: an item tag, eggs_min: 1..4, eggs_max: eggs_min..4}: after the player scatters one item with that tag at a `coop` place (GameState.feed_hens, once a day, world flag hens_fed_<region> = day), the next day this hen surely lays and the egg pile holds eggs_min..eggs_max eggs}: each day a hen may leave one egg near pos (Critters.eggs_today, seeded by region and day; GameState.pick_egg takes it, no time, back the next day; world flag eggs_<region> = {day, taken[]})}]; small code-drawn critters (Critters, CritterLayer): hens peck around pos all year, ducks drift on the pond landmark that contains pos (so pos must lie inside a pond, none in winter), butterflies flutter over pos in spring and summer; seeded by region id and day, none when Ambient effects is off, still under reduce_motion. forage (optional per region, FORAGE-001): {count: [min, max] (0..8), items: [{item: items.json id, weight > 0, min (int >= 1, default 1), max (int >= min, default min), seasons (optional list of spring|summer|autumn|winter), weather (optional, FORAGE-004: non-empty list of weather kinds; the item only rolls on those days), min_realm (optional realm id)}]}; Foraging.nodes picks today's visible pickups per region and day, deterministically; picking one (GameState.pick_forage) takes no time and it is gone until the next day. secret_realm places take an optional look (GFX-098): rift (default) | cleft | seal | gate | tomb | pavilion, a code-drawn entrance picture with a closed and an open state (PlaceLooks.REALM_LOOKS). map.decor.tree_kinds (optional, GFX-041): {round|pine|willow|dead|bamboo: weight > 0} picks each tree's kind (default all round); map.decor.blossoms (optional bool, default true): false = round trees never blossom; map.scree_density (optional float 0..1, GFX-079, default 1): share of the scree ground's speckle blobs; landmark kinds steps (stone treads, walkable) and clouds (pale cloud-sea band, never solid) are decorative; map.decor.edge_belt (optional int 0..3, GFX-089): rows of dense trees along all four map edges (gaps where a path or place blocks), so a forest closes in; map.decor.clusters (optional int 0..12): tree clumps of 4-7 trees seeded before the scatter; map.decor.rock_clusters (optional int 0..12, GFX-053): boulder groups of 3-6 rocks in 2-3 sizes seeded before the scatter; decor stays 12 px off path rects. roamers (optional per region, WILD-001): {count: [min, max] (0..6), enemies: [{enemy: enemies.json id with the beast tag that is not lethal, weight > 0, seasons (optional list of spring|summer|autumn|winter), min_realm (optional realm id: skipped below it), max_realm (optional realm id, WILD-018: skipped above it, not below min_realm), temper (optional, WILD-002: flees|wary|bold, default by threat to the player), in_season (optional, WILD-013: list of spring|summer|autumn|winter; in those seasons the beast's spoils roll twice and the arrival log adds a line naming it)}], great (optional, WILD-006): {enemy: a non-lethal beast, weekday (optional int 0..6, default a hash of the region id), min_realm (optional realm id), max_realm (optional realm id, WILD-019: not below min_realm; a player above it never meets this beast, the return beast walks for them instead), seasons (optional list), trophy (optional, WILD-007: an items.json id tagged trophy, given once per beast kind on the first win), bait (optional, WILD-015: non-empty list of items.json ids; on the day before the beast walks, spending one of these or any item tagged bait sets bait on the trail: the beast then starts the fight weakened), bait_weaken (optional float 0.02..0.5, default 0.1: the share of its hp and attack the baited beast loses), return (optional, WILD-014: {enemy: a non-lethal beast, trophy: an items.json id tagged trophy, min_realm (optional realm id, WILD-018: once the first beast is beaten it gates the slot instead of the parent's min_realm), max_realm (optional realm id, WILD-019: not below min_realm; above it nothing walks), rumor (optional, <= 140 chars)}; once the first beast is beaten (CharacterData.great_beasts) the slot spawns this enemy instead on the same weekday; its first win gives its own trophy and renown), trail_done_text (optional, WILD-021: <= 160 chars, {region}; the world line posted once when the last step of the chain is first beaten, which sets world flag great_trail_done_<region> and earns milestone great_trail_<region>; default "The hunters of {region} will tell this hunt for years."), rumor (optional, C-297: one non-empty sentence, <= 140 chars, a hunter's hint at the beast's look and temper without its name; shown under "???" on the village book trophy shelf and in the journal's great-beast road goal)}: that beast walks the map one day in seven (day % 7 == weekday), always wary, and its win pays double spoils}; Wildlife.roamers picks today's visible beasts per region and day, deterministically. festival_only (optional on a merchant place, FEST-012): a festival world event id (data/world_events.json, must have festival: true and list this region); the stall exists only while that festival runs in this region (Places.festival_open); its stock_tags work as usual. open_days (optional on a place, MARKET-002): non-empty list of day-of-month ints 1..30; the place exists only on those days (Places.is_open; the world builder adds/removes it as days pass, a merchant ignores clicks when closed; the journal hints the next one). A merchant stock_tags entry may be an item id as well as a tag. rotating_stock (optional on a merchant place, MARKET-007): {pool: [{item: items.json id with a price (within the place max_price, no restricted tag), weight > 0}], count: int 1..min(6, pool size)}; on each open day `count` distinct pool items are picked deterministically per (display_name, day) (Places.rotating_picks) and added to stock_tags (Places.stock_tags_today); the journal and the village calendar say the wares are new each time. wanted (optional on a place with rotating_stock, MARKET-008): {pool: [items.json ids with a price: forage, fish, hunt spoils], mult: 1.2..2.0}; on each open day one pool item is picked deterministically per (display_name, day) (Places.wanted_today); the stall buys it back (even if not otherwise in its goods) at mult x its sell price, up to 5 units per day (Places.WANTED_CAP, counted in a world flag), and the journal's market-day line says wants Boar Hide (x1.5). MARKET-009: wanted may carry regular_after (int >= 1, default 3) and regular_discount (0..0.3, default 0.1): selling the wanted item on that many different market days (CharacterData.market_regular, counted once per day; the per-day tally is one world flag market_wanted_sold {place: {day, sold}} overwritten each day) makes the player a regular there: the discount applies to the stall's rotating wares and the stall lays one more rotating pick (count + 1); the journal's market-day line says so. discount_flag (optional on a merchant place, WEATHER-006): {flag, buy_mult 0.5..1, tags [item tags]} multiplies buy prices of items with one of those tags while the timed/plain world flag is active (Shops.discount_mult). World regions. weather (optional per region, WEATHER-001): {season or 'any': {clear|cloudy|rain|snow|fog: weight > 0}} read by Weather.of (a season key beats 'any'; no weather = always clear); weather_effects (optional top-level, WEATHER-002): {rain: {herb_bonus_chance (0..1): each gathered stack of an item tagged herb has this chance to come with one extra}, snow: {travel_extra_days (int 1..5): a journey that starts from a region on a snow day takes this many more days}, storm (WEATHER-004): {herb_yield_penalty (int 1..3): every gathered herb stack yields this much less, min 0; dao_boost {insight (dao id), mult (1.0..3.0)}: contemplating that insight in seclusion gives mult times progress; Weather.dao_mult, GameState.contemplate_dao}; storm explore (WEATHER-005): {lightning_chance, thunderwood_chance (0..1, sum <= 1): one rng draw per day of exploring on a storm day; lightning_damage_frac (0..1, reserved: the game has no lasting hp, so lightning hurts only through the optional injury (injury id)); lightning with a Thunder Dao insight or a metal root 50+ gives one contemplation day of Thunder Dao progress instead; thunderwood adds one Lightning-struck Wood; Weather.storm_explore}; fishing_weather may list storm; any kind (clear, cloudy, rain, snow, fog, storm) may have qi_element (WEATHER-003): {element (metal/wood/water/fire/earth), mult (1.0..1.25)}: a character whose root has that element at 50+ cultivates mult times faster in a region on such a day (Weather.qi_mult, applied in GameState.region_qi_density)}; Weather.effect_note words them for the UI. fishing (optional top-level, FISH-006): {rain_extra_draws: int 0..3, default 1: extra draws a fishing trip makes on a rain day; a storm day refuses casting}; a catch_table entry may carry weather (non-empty list of weather kinds: it only rolls on those days). fishing_weather (optional top-level, FISH-001): {rain|snow|...: multiplier > 0} on the weight of every non-empty catch_table entry on a day with that weather (a clear day is x1); herb_lore (optional top-level, GATHER-001): {ranks: [{min (int, first 0, strictly rising), name}], xp_cap (int > 0: xp beyond it adds nothing), bonus_chance_max (0..1: chance at the cap that each gathered stack comes with one extra unit), rare_mult_max (>= 1: weight multiplier at the cap on rare gather entries, weight <= 2)}; HerbLore; absent = no herb lore. weather_persist (optional top-level, 0..1, default 0.6): chance a day keeps the previous day's weather. travel_speed (optional top-level, TRAV-007): [{min_realm (realm id), mult (0 < mult <= 1), how (non-empty phrase)}] with min_realm strictly rising; a traveller at or above an entry's realm takes max(1, ceil(days * mult)) days for each route, using the highest entry reached (below the first entry: on foot, full days); absent = everyone walks. road (optional top-level, TRAV-006): {chance_per_day, max_chance (0..1), encounter_tags (non-empty list)}: after a journey of N days an encounter tagged one of encounter_tags happens with probability min(max_chance, chance_per_day * N); absent = no road encounters. qi_flags (optional, QI-001): [{flag (world flag), bonus (0 < bonus <= 0.5), text (optional reason)}]: while the world flag is truthy the region's qi density is multiplied by 1 + the sum of active bonuses. The world scene builds itself from the current region. qi_density multiplies cultivation everywhere in the region (meditation spots multiply again). routes: travel targets with days and an optional min_realm (realm id). places: interactables; 'anchor_id' (optional, globally unique) makes the place a Creation Artifact anchor (data/artifact.json); 'type' picks the script (deed_giver only: optional 'look' {robe (hex, default the place color), hair (dark/grey), style (bun/long/hood), child (bool), kind (figure/camp: camp draws a tent and fire, no person)}, GFX-018; meditation, merchant, sect_hall, workshop, clinic, orphanage (adopt a foundling, FAM-003e), auction (an auction house: house_id names a data/auctions.json house, AUC-001b), bounty_board (a board of Bounties offers, WU-076), coop (CRIT-002: "Scatter grain" feeds the region's hens, see map.ambient_critters lays.feed), inheritance (inheritance grounds listing every data/inheritances.json inheritance in the region, W-006b), deed_giver, gather (optional 'look', GFX-102: patch (default) | rubble | crater | crystal | frost | terrace | bog, PixelPlace.gather_kind), explore (optional 'look', GFX-095: cave (default), woods, ruins, reeds, ridge or trail picks the site's code-drawn picture, PixelPlace.explore_kind), travel, gather, field_plot (FARM-001: a rentable field, one per region; plots 1..4, rent (spirit stones), rent_days, plants {item: {days >= 1, yield [min, max]}}, rain_bonus_days 0..3 (extra growth days when it rains), frozen_seasons (no growth), wood_bonus 0..2 (default 1: extra harvest for a Wood root 50+), a plants entry may carry seasons (FARM-003: non-empty list of spring/summer/autumn/winter; it can only be planted in those seasons, a crop already in the ground keeps growing; missing = any season), nourish_qi (FARM-004, optional int >= 1, default 30: qi a cultivator spends to advance the crops 2 days, 3 with a Wood root 50+, once a day), tended_share (FARM-005, optional 0 < x <= 1, default 0.25) and tended_bonus (optional int 0..3, default 1: a crop watered or nourished on at least ceil(days * tended_share) days yields tended_bonus more), expand_cost + max_plots (FARM-002, optional together: expand_cost > 0 spirit stones, once, raises the plots to max_plots (plots..8); the player can also water a growing field by hand on a clear or cloudy day, once a day, which makes the next day grow like a rain day); FieldPlots), fishing (FISH-001: a pond; 'catch_table' has the format of a gather_table, 'gather_days' is the fishing trip length), secret_realm: lists every data/secret_realms.json realm whose region is this one; a gather place's gather_table entries are {item ('' = nothing), weight, min, max, min_realm (optional realm id: below it the entry counts as nothing found), seasons (optional list of spring/summer/autumn/winter, SEASON-001: the entry only rolls in those seasons; absent = all year)}), 'pos' and 'size' are in pixels, other keys are passed to the script as exported properties. discovery_rumor (optional, GUIDE-015): one sentence of gossip about the region's discovery, shown in the journal and by merchants until discovered; only on a region that has a discovery. discovery (optional, TRAV-005): an encounter id (data/encounters.json, marked discovery_only) that your first exploration of this region always finds, once (world flag discovered_<region>). festival_square (optional, GFX-085): [x, y] inside the map bounds, at least 160 px from every map edge (GFX-090) and at least 80 px from every place; while a contest festival runs in the region its contest stall and the villager crowd gather there instead of beside a merchant. npc_spots (optional): list of [x, y] positions where generated NPCs living in the region stand (in id order; extra NPCs gather around the spawn point). family_home (optional, FAM-011): {pos, size} of the Family Home drawn in the region while any of the player's living spouses or children live there; they take the npc_spots nearest to it. first_visit (optional, TRAV-002): 1-3 sentences posted to the message log the first time the player travels to the region. quiet_lines (optional Array of short non-empty strings) are flavour scenes appended to quiet exploring days, picked by day number (no randomness). encounter_tags select entries from data/encounters.json when exploring. map_pos (optional): [x, y] fractions 0..1 placing the region on the world map screen (regions without it are spread around the map edge). abodes (optional, G-010): claimable cave abodes in the region, each {id (globally unique), display_name, cost (spirit stones), min_realm (optional realm id), qi_density (multiplies cultivation in seclusion there, like a meditation spot), storage_slots (distinct item stacks its chest holds), anchor_id (optional, globally unique: the abode can be bound as a Creation Artifact anchor), pos, size, color (layout for the world scene)}. The player owns at most one abode (Abodes). hunt (optional on a region, WILD-016): {days: int 1..10, bonus: float 0..1, target_region: a region with roamers}; on the first market day of a season in which target_region has an in_season roamer, the region's bounty board offers a joint village hunt for `days` days, once a season: you fight that beast with the village hunters adding `bonus` of your attack, its spoils roll twice and every villager living in the region gains 1 favor (VillageHunt, GameState.join_village_hunt). The reserved stock tag "untagged" (MARKET-010, added automatically to a rotating_stock stall without stock_tags) also sells untagged items; no item may carry it. A merchant's optional 'stock_tags' (item tags it sells and buys back) and 'buy_tags' (item tags it only buys back, e.g. a general trader taking herbs and ore). A merchant's optional 'faction' (sect id) makes its prices follow your reputation with that sect (data/sects.json reputation tiers). encounter_tags select entries from data/encounters.json when exploring. map.ground_style (optional, GFX-042): grass (default), paved (flagstones and a wide street), scree (pebbles and cracks) bog (standing water and reeds) or litter (grass with dark leaf specks), GroundTiles._apply_style. map.plaza (optional, GFX-054, only with ground_style paved): [x, y, w, h] in map px, an extra flagstone area (a market square); a paved map lays flagstones only within 80 px of its paths and inside the plaza, the rest is packed earth (Scenery.paved_zones). map.water (optional, GFX-103): clear (default blue pond) | murky (dark rim, lily pads) | icy (pale blue, white rim), the look of every pond landmark in the region (PlaceLooks.WATER_KINDS; a landmark `color` still sets the tint); map.building_style (optional, GFX-100): thatch (default) | tile | stone | stilt | log, recolours (and for stilt/log lightly reshapes) workshop, clinic, orphanage, family home, auction, shop and merchant buildings and house landmarks (PixelPlace.STYLE_COLORS). map.mist (optional float 0..1, default 1, GFX-044): scales the alpha of the fog-weather sheets and the mist ambient over the region (World._mist_strength); map.no_snow (optional bool, GFX-039): true keeps the region's ground and paths in their summer look in winter (GroundTiles.ground_season). map.ambient (optional, WU-057): particles drifting over the region, {season: kind} with season spring/summer/autumn/winter or any (a season entry wins over any) and kind one of petals, leaves, snow, mist, embers, fireflies (src/world/ambient.gd); the Ambient effects setting turns them off. map.landmarks (optional, GFX-008, GFX-012): hand-placed scenery [{kind (house, field, pond, fence, well, wall, cliff, stream, lantern, pine, stall), pos [x, y] = the centre, size [w, h] > 0, color (optional hex: a pond's water, e.g. a bog), tree_kind (optional, GFX-046, only on a pine: round|pine|willow|dead|bamboo, default pine: drawn with that decor tree painter)}]; a jetty landmark within 160 px of a pond is laid from the pond's rim toward its pos (Scenery.jetty_layout), drawn over paths and under decor (no decor is placed in or near them); house, well, wall, cliff, lantern, pine and stall are solid (the player walks around them), so keep every place, npc spot, family home and the spawn point outside those and leave gaps in walls for roads; a stream is walkable and draws a plank bridge where it crosses a path. map.decor (optional): scenery drawn on the map, counts trees/rocks/grass/flowers (0-300) and colors tree_color/rock_color/grass_color/flower_color (hex); missing keys use Scenery.DEFAULTS. renown (optional, RENOWN-001): local fame per region (CharacterData.renown). sources: renown gained per source (bounty, discovery, deep_path, righteous_deed, commission (a delivered commission), patients (a patient-treating session), great_beast (WILD-010: a great-beast win); ints >= 0); tiers: [{min, title, buy_mult, bounty_mult (optional, float >= 1.0, default 1.0: the share of a bounty's reward paid on top in that region)}] with the first min 0, min strictly rising, buy_mult in (0, 1] (the share of the buy price paid in that region; sell prices never change), title a String; max: the cap per region (int > 0). greetings (optional, NEWS-002): [{min_tier (int >= 1, an index into tiers), text (non-empty; {name} = the NPC, {title} = your title there)}]: when you chat with someone, a line with min_tier <= your tier there is posted, picked by the day number. Absent = no renown. sect_hall places (MISSION-002) take an optional `sect` (a sects.json id): only that sect's disciples use its mission board; absent = open to every disciple.

greetings.text: {name} brightens: so you are the one they call {title}.
{name} nods to you: word of the {title} has reached even here.
{name} straightens respectfully: it is an honour, {title}.
{name} bows low: everyone here knows the {title} by name.

regions.name: Qingshi Village
regions.discovery_rumor: Old folk say the founders left something at the village well, if you know to look past the last house.
regions.description: A sleepy mortal village where your journey begins.
regions.first_visit: Smoke curls from a few thatched roofs and a dog barks once, then loses interest. The old elder watches from his doorstep, and the green slope behind the houses is thick with common herbs.
quiet_lines: Smoke curls from the village chimneys; a dog barks twice and thinks better of it.
You follow a field path past bent backs and drying millet. Nobody looks up.
A child chases a chicken across the lane and loses.
The well-rope creaks. Somewhere a woman is singing off-key over her washing.
Dust settles behind an ox cart. The driver nods to you and says nothing.
Rain threatens all afternoon and never arrives.
Up at the old quarry, a boy sifts the grey tailings for rust-red flecks and calls it work.
You count the roofs, the fences, the stray cats. Nothing here has changed.
Hunter Ma oils a boar spear on his doorstep and tells nobody what the forest said to him.
Two hunters argue about which wind carries a stag's scent, and neither of them notices you pass.

regions.name: Misty Forest
regions.description: Ancient trees veiled in mist. Spirit herbs grow here, and so do spirit beasts.

great.trail_done_text: The {region} is quiet. No tusk scars the oak bark, and the woodcutters walk the old boar's trail without once looking back.

return.rumor: Hunters say the old boar keeps a sow, and she is quicker to charge than he is.
A scarred old boar with one tusk gone keeps the deep forest, and hunters who have crossed him give his trail a wide berth.

great.rumor: Something broad as a cart and older than the village road keeps the deep forest, and it charges any hunter who walks its trail.

regions.first_visit: The road dissolves into mist between trunks wider than a village well. Somewhere deeper in, something large moves, and the herbs at your feet glow faintly, as if they know you are new here.
quiet_lines: Mist pools in the hollows; somewhere a wolf calls and is answered.
You trace a deer track until it fades into moss and silence.
Dew drips from the high leaves like a slow clock.
A cold current of qi brushes your ankles, then drifts away between the trunks.
Bird-song stops all at once, and starts again a moment later.
You find old claw marks on a tree, high above your head, and walk on more quietly.
The fog thickens until your own hand is a rumour. You wait it out.
regions.discovery_rumor: Herb-pickers say an old shrine hides in a hollow tree somewhere in the Misty Forest.

regions.name: Fallen Star Market
regions.discovery_rumor: Stallkeepers whisper that one stall in the crater lip was never cleared away.
regions.description: A bustling free city where rogue cultivators trade treasures and rumours.
regions.first_visit: Lanterns, haggling and a dozen dialects crash over you at once. Stall after stall of unlabelled treasures line the lanes, and a gong somewhere announces that the auction is about to begin.
quiet_lines: Hawkers cry their wares in six dialects; none of them is for you.
You drift between stalls. A masked cultivator brushes past and is gone.
Lantern light shivers on the wet flagstones.
Two rogue cultivators haggle over a cracked jade slip, then part friends.
The smell of frying dough and scorched talisman paper hangs over the lanes.
A cart of ore rumbles by under the eye of a bored guard.
You overhear a rumour that is plainly a lie, and plainly told well.

great.trail_done_text: The cloud line holds only wind now. Climbers say the last white crane's cry is gone, and the crags answer with silence.

return.rumor: Climbers talk of a second, greyer crane circling the lower crags, and she does not wait for you to look up.
A white crane with a broken crown haunts the cloud line, and climbers say she strikes before they see her.

great.rumor: A tall white bird with a plumed crown nests above the cloud line and stabs at climbers who come too close.

regions.name: Azure Peak
regions.discovery_rumor: Herb-pickers speak of a clean cut in the cliffs above the cloud line, and orchids that grow beside it.
regions.description: Cloud-wreathed mountains thick with qi. Fierce beasts guard the heights.
regions.first_visit: The path climbs until the clouds are below you, and a sect hall floats on the white sea like a ship at anchor. Along the cliffs, terraced beds of spirit herbs steam in the thin bright air.
quiet_lines: Wind scours the ridge; far below, clouds roll like a slow white sea.
You climb a switchback of wet stone and find only more switchback.
A hawk hangs on the updraft, watching you, then slides away.
Frost glitters on the rocks where the qi runs thin and sharp.
Your breath smokes. The peak keeps its own counsel.
Rockfall rattles in the distance, and then nothing.
You rest in the lee of a boulder and watch the sun set the clouds on fire.

great.trail_done_text: The old hummock no longer croaks. The fog-walkers pole through the marsh in the hush the last bog-king left behind.

return.rumor: Fog-walkers speak of a younger toad on the lesser hummocks, and say his tongue is faster than his father's.
A warty, scarred bog-king croaks low and loud from the oldest hummock, and the fog-walkers say he has swallowed more than fog.

great.rumor: Something sits on the marsh's oldest hummock and croaks like a drum; the fog-walkers say it swallows whatever drifts near.

regions.name: Withered Bone Marsh
regions.discovery_rumor: Boatmen say a green lantern burns on a cairn somewhere in the marsh, and the mist parts around it.
regions.description: A drowned battlefield from an ancient sect war. Yin qi pools in the black water, and demonic cultivators come to refine it.
regions.first_visit: The black water does not ripple, and every bone in the mud is older than any grave you know. Somewhere in the reeds a lamp burns where no one should be, and corpse-refiners are said to keep such lamps.
quiet_lines: Black water shivers though there is no wind.
Your boots suck at the mud; something small plops into the reeds.
Pale lights drift over the far pools and do not come closer.
The air tastes of old iron and rot. You breathe through your sleeve.
A rusted spearhead juts from the peat, and you leave it where it lies.
Frogs fall silent as you pass and resume behind you.
Fog crawls over the bog, carrying a faint, tuneless humming.

great.trail_done_text: No thunder rolls off the high ridge. The shepherds count their flocks twice, then a third time, and find none missing.

return.rumor: Shepherds say the grey ram came back with a cracked horn, and the lightning no longer seems to frighten him.

great.rumor: Shepherds swear a grey, curl-horned beast of the high ridge has been struck by lightning a hundred times and shrugged it off.

regions.name: Myriad Peaks Ridge
regions.discovery_rumor: Travellers claim a beast king's ribs still arch over a hollow in the lee of the ridge.
regions.description: A knife-edge ridge above the cloud sea where the ten thousand peaks meet. Ancient cultivators fought and died here, and the qi runs thick and hungry.
regions.first_visit: The ridge narrows to a blade above the cloud sea, and the wind carries the roar of beasts as old as the peaks themselves. Along the stone, a few flat ledges hum with qi, waiting for someone bold enough to sit.
quiet_lines: The ridge runs on ahead, knife-thin, with cloud on both sides.
Wind moans through a split in the rock like a voice trying to remember words.
You pass the stump of a shattered pillar, scorched and ancient, and say nothing.
Thin starlight glints on a scatter of old, weathered bone.
The qi here is thick and restless; it prickles along your arms.
A far peak flashes once with lightning, and the sound arrives late.
You walk until your legs ache and the ridge looks exactly the same.
